verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-access API for agents. Its AI-generated outputs, such as Research reports and qna_search answers, are drawn from public web sources, not from the user's own data inside the product. The usage and logs endpoints return raw account data with no documented AI-generated insights or suggestions, so there is no evidence of this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
